nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=20 beats='It is the second morning of the school holidays, and Miri has promised Mrs. Alvarez she will look after the coop until term starts again. She swings open the gate with the feed bucket in hand, ready for the same easy routine as yesterday.'>>
